_comment: Bundle budgets (bytes). A ratchet: ceilings pin today's build and may only go down. initial = entry script + modulepreloaded chunks + css from index.html. Known exception: vendor-echarts is still preloaded at first load (1.1 MB); shrinking it is tracked, growing it is a failure. Raised once, Owner-approved 2026-10-30: entry_script_bytes 2400000 -> 2405000 (+5000) for the request-loop guard (lib/guardedFetch.ts + requestLoopGuard.ts + the common.requestBlocked strings in the eager locales), a safety backstop that must load with the first request; it put the entry at 2402282. Lowered 2026-10-30 after lib/mock moved out of the entry (loaded on demand by main.tsx under ?mock=1): entry 2402282 -> 2374669 and initial 4188373 measured; ceilings entry 2405000 -> 2380000 and initial_total 4300000 -> 4195000 (5-7 KB headroom for small eager additions). initial_forbidden_strings: 'demo.user' is the mock fixtures' user id (lib/mock/fixtures.ts MOCK_USER_ID); finding it in a first-load file means the fixtures were statically imported again. Raised, Owner-approved 2026-10-30: entry_script_bytes 2380000 -> 2385000 (+5000) and initial_total_bytes 4195000 -> 4200000 (+5000; the entry is part of the initial set, so its raise must carry over or the initial gate trips first) for the failure-based request-loop guard (in-flight slots, failure budget, the slow-backend message in the eager locales) and the follow-up global fetch guard — both must load with the first request; this restores small-eager-change headroom instead of trimming the guard's diagnostics. Measured at this raise: entry 2380002, initial 4193706. Still 20 KB / 100 KB under the 2405000 / 4300000 before the mock move.
